subject: Provisioning change history + RBAC snapshots request (SOC2 evidence)
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@finvault.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Provisioning change history + RBAC snapshots request (SOC2 evidence)

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for taking this SOC2 evidence request. Our InfoSec team asked us to collect the following artifacts for the last 6 months to validate provisioning and access controls across the integration with Redwood: 

- SCIM delta exports covering the last 6 months (incremental changes with timestamps and actor)
- RBAC snapshot(s) for the tenant scoped roles (roles.json with role -> principal mapping) as-of 2026-06-30
- Audit excerpt showing provisioning events (create/update/deactivate) for service accounts and admin role escalations
- A short README describing how the exports were generated and any filters applied (sensitive data redaction guidance)

Could you confirm whether Redwood can provide a) raw SCIM deltas (CSV or JSONL), b) RBAC snapshot as JSON, and c) a short description of the extraction procedure? If possible please indicate any PII fields we should redact on our side.

Target deadline from our auditor is EOD 2026-07-16. If you need an extension, please let us know.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Nguyen
IT Compliance Manager | FinVault
alice.nguyen@finvault.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@finvault.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisioning change history + RBAC snapshots request (SOC2 evidence)

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the artifacts you listed; proposed plan below: 

1) SCIM deltas: export as CSV with columns (timestamp, operation, resourceType, externalId, actor, changedAttributes). Filtered to exclude user.email and user.phone by default — we will mark those columns with REDACTED and provide guidance in the README.
2) RBAC snapshot: role_catalog.json and assignment_snapshot.json (role definitions + principal assignments) as-of 2026-06-30. We will scope to tenant: finvault-prod.
3) Provisioning audit excerpt: plain text log slice (10k rows max) showing provisioning operations and the initiating principal; we will include an abbreviated sample of escalation events.
4) README: process, queries used, redaction notes and owner contact.

Laura and Karthik — could you confirm we can deliver the CSV/JSON exports and estimate when the exports can be ready (targeting 7/15 to give FinVault a day to review)? Also confirm the maximum log slice size we should provide for the auditor.

Alice — if there's a specific HubSpot or ticket ID to attach, send it over and we'll include it in the README.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@finvault.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisioning change history + RBAC snapshots request (SOC2 evidence)

Hi Alice —

We're on it. Quick notes and deliverables: 

- Deliverables we will attach to this thread: scim_delta_2026-06-30.csv (6 months), rbac_snapshot_2026-06-30.json (role defs + assignments), provisioning_audit_log_excerpt.txt (filtered), readme_delivery_notes.txt
- Redaction: we will redact PII columns user.email and user.phone and replace them with mosaic values (e.g., user_email_redacted). Service account IDs and role IDs will be left intact.
- Size/format: CSV for SCIM delta (~18k rows), JSON for RBAC snapshot (role_catalog + assignments). If auditor needs full logs we can provide paginated extracts but prefer to start with the slice.
- Owner: Karthik will run the extraction. Estimated ETA: first package ready for internal review by 2026-07-14 EOD; final delivery to FinVault by 2026-07-15 EOD.

Karthik — please confirm the extraction job, attach the initial readme, and upload the artifacts to the shared Drive link above.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Security Programs | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@finvault.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T11:58:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisioning change history + RBAC snapshots request (SOC2 evidence)

Hi all —

Extraction completed and initial package uploaded to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/finvault-evidence-123 (link expires in 14 days). Files included (zipped):

- scim_delta_2026-06-30.csv (CSV, 18,240 rows)
- rbac_snapshot_2026-06-30.json (role_catalog + assignment_snapshot)
- provisioning_audit_log_excerpt.txt (10k-row slice; includes escalation events)
- readme_delivery_notes.txt (extraction queries, redaction notes, contact)

Notes for FinVault: the SCIM export omits user.email and user.phone by default per our standard redaction policy; if your auditor requires those fields in a controlled manner please request a signed NDA addendum and we can provide masked samples or a redaction key under a secure transfer.

Alice — please confirm receipt and whether you want the package uploaded to your S3 or if the Drive link is sufficient. I'll hand off any rotation keys to security if you need a deeper log extract.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Provisioning Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
